        width=beam_width, height=beam_height,

        width=2.0, height=beam_height,
        angle=0, density=beam_density,
    )

    strut_xs = [6.0, 7.0, 8.0, 9.0, 11.0, 12.0, 13.0, 14.0]

            width=0.2, height=0.4,
            angle=0, density=beam_density,

        strut_bodies.append((sx, s))
        # Connect to ground

        # Connect to deck beams
